headline: Jinzo
title: Jinzo Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Jinzo. What is it? It is a Level six DARK Machine with two thousand four hundred attack. In the anime it was Joey's Deck Master in the virtual world. What does it do? While Jinzo is on the field, Trap Cards and their effects on the field cannot be activated, and all Trap effects on the field are negated. How do you use it? Summon it against a trap-heavy opponent. Remember it stops your own Traps too. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
